profileFields.bioShort: Custom packaging for cosmetics, gifts, e-commerce and specialty retail products. Shenzhen source factory. Buyer briefs welcome.

postAngles.title: Rigid gift box sampling checklist
postAngles.caption: Before sampling a rigid gift box, we usually check product size, weight, insert style, finish direction and sales channel first. A box can look premium and still fail if the product fit is unclear. For custom packaging briefs: mugepackaging.com

postAngles.title: Paper tube packaging buyer note
postAngles.caption: Paper tube packaging works well for candles, tea, skincare sets and small gifts when diameter, height, cap style and surface finish are decided early. The practical work starts with the product, not the tube catalog.

postAngles.title: Clear PET/PVC box sourcing note
postAngles.caption: For transparent retail boxes, buyers usually need to confirm display effect, scratch risk, product weight and folding/gluing structure before choosing PET or PVC. A clear box is useful only when the product still looks clean after shipping.
